name: The young man with the cart (the newer grain seller)
aliases: the young man with the cart

physicalDetails.detail: Described by Joss (via Sylvanas): young, civil, brown hair 'he thinks. Or fair', a good horse, a cart. Not seen on page. Likely 'a young man' in the carter's farewell too (not established).

voiceMarkers.detail: Reported only: civil, bought Joss a jug at the alehouse the first time, paying in good coin, asking after his wife's leg.

goalsAtChapterEnd.active: Unknown; his flour has been burned in this village; his road leads south and west.

decisionsThisChapter.detail: (Reported) Three months ago came through from the west road with a cart selling barley and flour cheaper than the valley farms by two coppers on the measure; has sold the keeper four loads, the last a fortnight ago; the sacks in the loft are stencilled ANDORHAL (a sheaf of wheat in a ring). (NOT established: whether he is the one who placed Tam or the jar; Tam only says 'I'm not to speak to you'.)

abilitiesDemonstrated.ability: Wins trust by price and charm; leaves nothing but a description that fits many; operates in more than one village (Millhaven's 'newer grain seller, cheaper than Mister Hollis' and this village's new man are linked by Jaina's thought and Sylvanas's presence).

howOthersAddressHim.speaker: Joss/Brask
howOthersAddressHim.pattern: 'the new man', 'a young man with a cart'

arc.currentPosition: Unfound. The party follows 'the road he drove' south and west.
